title: Frequent reminder user
body:
Love this app. Very easy to setup and go. 
Could do with more flexibility for the frequency of reminders. I need one every half hour for say 14 hours a day but it only supports 20 reminders max so in one day can only have for 10 hours. 
Seems like an arbitrary number- 20. Could it be typed in then the app does the maths?

author: PeterFG

title: Best habit tracker out.. almost
body: Love everything about it, however would like to make just one suggestion. I found out recently that colours add incentive to using phones and apps and I personally love seeing the full spectrum (or as much as my phone allows) of vibrant colours in apps. Makes it more enjoyable to use tbh. I feel that if customisation of colours for each habit were added I would be more inclined to want to open the app frequently. I know that this may clash with the colour scheme for the due, done and pending indicators on the LHS but even just a subtle hint of colour in the text or BG of the habit would really help distinguish between habits (especially useful when you have a load of them like I do) and add more ‘umph’ the UI a bit. That or, like a lot of other habit tracking apps, you could add little icons or pictographs with custom colours that help easily identify the habit. Thanks for reading :) and thanks for the great app!

title: Awesome tool for Adult ADHD
body: Thanks so much for your app. It has eased the functional issues with my executive function deficits and the resulting distractability regarding mundane and repetitive tasks (mainly housework and self care) I highly recommend this as a tool for Adults, Teens and even kids with ADHD. The progress tracker is particularly useful for gauging overall compliance and improvement. The ability to set up Nagging reminders help too. Love that you can actually erase days from the statistics when needed so genuine reasons for noncompliance are not going to ruin the positive reinforcement you receive from your streaks. Absolutely worth paying the tiny fee to get unlimited tasks. Great range of options for intervals between tasks and types of tasks. Just Buy It ALREADY!!!
